question: Can the TEVp-0 single-mutant by single-mutant-substrate screen support a frozen interaction-generalization benchmark against an additive protease-row plus substrate-column baseline?

decision_rule.continue: Continue only if the released data retain a lossless join from every scored activity to exact protease and substrate identities after the authors' filtering and control corrections, and if the split leaves the additive comparator identifiable.
decision_rule.stop: Stop if exact processed pair identity cannot be reconstructed, if cross-screen pooling is required, or if a proposed two-axis split makes row or column effects unidentified.

study.citation: Huber et al., Data-driven protease engineering by DNA-recording and epistasis-aware machine learning, Nature Communications 16, 5466 (2025)

paper_reported_surface.read_threshold: at least 20 reads per sampling time point and barcode pair

checked_in_aggregate.path: 2 Data analysis (Lukas Huber)/uASPIre screen4 and 5_2022_08_11/uASPIre screen4_DMS/data/Data_DMS.txt.zip
checked_in_aggregate.interpretation: The aggregate preserves exact TEVp and TEVs identities and AUC values, but predates the barcode-level mutated-backbone, replicate-divergence, false-positive and positive-control corrections used by the released analysis. Treating its extra 10,980 pairs as the paper cohort would silently change the endpoint.

correction_dependency.why_required: The released 01.1 and 04 scripts perform mutated-backbone removal and replicate-level correction from barcode-level rows. Those barcode identities are absent from Data_DMS.txt, so the published 355,097-pair cohort cannot be reconstructed from the smaller aggregate.

source_data_workbook.identity_limit: The figure sheet retains substrate position, substrate amino acid and activity, but no TEVp identity. It therefore cannot restore the exact processed protease-substrate join.

control_endpoint.method: The source code fits a normal distribution to selected inactive controls, uses its 95th percentile as cutoff, sets sub-cutoff activity to the control mean and subtracts that mean.
control_endpoint.known_limit: The authors' own Shapiro-Wilk checks reject normality for the pooled and individual controls except most P1-prime-only subsets. This is a source-described thresholding choice, not a calibrated cleavage-rate scale.
control_endpoint.bond_limit: Recorder activation is not product mapping to the intended peptide bond.

checkerboard_pair_holdout.identifiability: A row-plus-column additive baseline is identifiable only when every test protease and every test substrate is observed with other partners in training.
checkerboard_pair_holdout.supported_claim_if_data_existed: New-combination interpolation within one TEVp-0 reporter campaign.
checkerboard_pair_holdout.not_supported: Unseen protease-mutation or unseen substrate-mutation generalization.

double_cold_row_and_column_holdout.identifiability: Holding entire protease and substrate identities out of training makes their row and column effects unestimable. Comparing an interaction model with that additive identity baseline is therefore ill-posed.
double_cold_row_and_column_holdout.repair: A cold-start task would require predefined mutation descriptors or structural features for both axes and a different baseline; it would answer a different question.

split_audit.conclusion: The inherited phrase 'two-axis blocked folds' conflated checkerboard interaction interpolation with double-cold mutation generalization. No fold outcomes were computed.

decision.conclusion: Do not preregister or score the proposed Huber DMS benchmark from the currently bounded source bundle.
decision.scientific_consequence: The public study demonstrates a large within-campaign single-mutant activity map, but the bounded released artifacts inspected here do not provide a lossless exact-identity table for the published processed cohort. Scoring the smaller raw aggregate would preserve identities while changing the authors' filtering; scoring the figure workbook would preserve processed values while discarding protease identity.
decision.atlas_contribution: The audit adds a reusable benchmark constraint: pair-level interaction evaluation requires processed endpoint values and both exact pair identities in the same recoverable artifact, and split geometry must keep the chosen additive comparator identifiable.

next_action.action: Qualify a different public single-campaign cleavage matrix whose processed table retains exact enzyme identity, exact substrate identity, quantitative negatives and the complete filtering contract in one bounded artifact.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Such a matrix could support a genuinely frozen checkerboard interaction test without changing the assay cohort or confusing interpolation with cold-start generalization.
next_action.stop: Stop after one bounded candidate if either pair identities, quantitative negatives, or the processing contract is absent; do not weaken the endpoint to continue dataset search.

source_acquisition.note: Only selected ZIP members were range-fetched from the 35,182,821-byte source workbook. Decompressed local bytes are not network acquisition. The 35,178,112-byte barcode-level archive was not downloaded.
